value.rationale: Natural feedback-vertex-number-one family is an all-order structural threshold. The theorem constructs explicit strong collapses (excluding noncollapsible contractible examples) and forbids all higher integral homology in a large family where general tournament flag complexes can have complicated topology; the example separates homotopy type from strong connectivity. A complete sharp dichotomy, not an arbitrary numeric census or a mere rephrasing of free fundamental groups.
